decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a peripheral consumer product with little investment and no public commitment, so the firm loses little and has nothing to justify by dropping it to focus on its core technologies.
The modular plant extensions are part of the established waste-to-energy line and support the flagship plants, so dropping them would undercut the firm's core direction.

WASTX Oil was publicly launched as a flagship with a press release and has its own page, so heavy investment and visible commitment favour persisting and blaming weak results on temporary market conditions.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is presented as central to the firm's announced sustainability direction, so management would keep it rather than write off the development investment.
